summary.zh: 八套精选配色，为 DeepDeep 换一种气质
summary.en: Eight curated palettes that give DeepDeep a different mood

description.zh:
为主题库加入海盐、苔原、晚霞、樱、墨玉、夜航、咖啡与石墨八套固定配色，在设置 → 主题里一键切换。
主题只改变颜色，主界面、插件页面、系统助手浮层、悬浮窗与状态栏会一起生效；不需要工具或后台权限。
description.en:
Adds eight fixed palettes — Harbor, Tundra, Dusk, Sakura, Jade, Nightfall, Mocha and Graphite — to the theme library, switched from Settings → Theme.
Themes only change colours and apply across the main UI, plugin pages, the assistant overlay, floating windows and the status bar; no tools or background access are required.
